page_title: EMP 0-1 VER | Empoli v Verona 19/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Luca Massimi is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' The corner is swung in but Verona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Empoli comes to nothing.
90+3' Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90+2' 16:16 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
88' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Josh Doig and he is replaced by Juan David Cabal (Verona).
88' Substitution. Bruno Amione (Verona) on for Ondrej Duda.
88' Riccardo Saponara (Verona) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
87' Josh Doig (Verona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Elia Caprile intercepts the ball.
86' Paolo Zanetti prepares a substitution. Emmanuel Gyasi is replaced by Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli).
86' Substitution. Alberto Grassi makes way for Liam Henderson (Empoli).
85' Diego Coppola (Verona) commits a rough challenge and Luca Massimi blows his whistle for a foul.

84' Great solo effort by Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.
80' A corner kick by Empoli is thwarted by the well prepared Lorenzo Montipo (Verona).
80' Stiven Shpendi (Empoli) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the left post and forces a good save out of Lorenzo Montipo.
79' That will be all from Liberato Cacace who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli).
77' Verona have a goal ruled out for offside!
77' Referee Luca Massimi points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) goes wild in celebration.
76' The Verona players halt their celebrations as referee Luca Massimi makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
75' 0 - 1 Goal! Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 0:1.
75' Ondrej Duda (Verona) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
74' Josh Doig (Verona) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Verona.
72' The referee blows for a cooling break.
70' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Francesco Caputo will be replaced by Roberto Piccoli (Empoli).
70' Paolo Zanetti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Stiven Shpendi (Empoli) replacing Matteo Cancellieri.
69' Here's the change. Michael Folorunsho leaves the pitch and Riccardo Saponara (Verona) comes on as a substitute.
69' We are about to witness a subsitution. Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) for Cyril Ngonge.
69' A substitution has been made. Jordi Mboula is replaced by Milan Djuric (Verona).
68' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
68' Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
66' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
64' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) jumps into a tackle and Luca Massimi signals a foul.
61' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick.
60' Razvan Marin (Empoli) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
59' Empoli are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
58' Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
56' Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) commits a rough challenge and Luca Massimi blows his whistle for an infringement. Verona are awarded the free kick.
55' Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
53' Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
52' Francesco Caputo (Empoli) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
49' A crossfield pass from Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) fails to find any of his teammates.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Luca Massimi blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
45+2' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Razvan Marin (Empoli) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
44' Today's referee Luca Massimi rightly decides to book Ondrej Duda (Verona) for his harsh tackle.

42' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.

42' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Elia Caprile anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom right corner.
38' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) is able to continue to play.
37' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
37' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Empoli is cautioned for aggressive play.
35' Good clearance! Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
33' Josh Doig (Verona) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
32' Francesco Caputo (Empoli) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
30' Fine play by Jordi Mboula (Verona) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles past the left post.
28' Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
26' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
24' Luca Massimi interrupts the game. One of the players from Verona won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
22' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Verona.
21' Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
19' The ball is out of play. Verona will take a throw-in.
16' Verona earn a corner.
14' Francesco Caputo (Empoli) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
12' Luca Massimi blows the whistle, Michael Folorunsho (Verona) is penalised for a foul.
12' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
11' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post.
8' Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
5' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
3' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Verona.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Verona will take the kick-off.
Luca Massimi will supervise the game today.
